title: EVT:EXPOSURE_SUMMARY_UPDATED payload schema
description: Emitted by execution_position after a fill or portfolio update with current margin exposure summary.

exposure_summary.description: Current margin exposure summary from ExposureGuard

portfolio_state.description: Latest portfolio state at time of emission

fill_order_id.description: Order ID that triggered this update (fill path only)

fill_symbol.description: Symbol of the fill that triggered this update

fill_quantity.description: Fill quantity that triggered this update

timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp of the exposure summary in milliseconds
